title: How long after starting Speech Therapy can we expect to see changes in our child with Autism?
metaTitle: Timeline for Progress in Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand the timeline for seeing improvements in your child with autism after starting Speech Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand the anticipation you feel to see your child's progress. However, the journey of Speech Therapy varies for each child, some noticing improvements within a few weeks, while for others, it can take several months. This diverse timeframe is reflective of each child's unique strengths and challenges. But remember, the road to progress is often paved with consistency, perseverance, and an abundance of love and patience.
